description: This file defines the AddressFormat class within the Opencart Admin Controller Localisation namespace. It manages CRUD operations and listing for address formats in the OpenCart admin panel, including rendering views and handling form submissions.

classes.name: AddressFormat
classes.description: Controller class managing address formats in the OpenCart admin localisation section. Provides methods for listing, adding, editing, and deleting address formats.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of address formats with pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of address formats in the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and returns HTML view for the list of address formats.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the address format creation/edit form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving (adding/editing) address formats via AJAX.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected address formats via AJAX.
